info.title: idrak: Idrak's command-line tool
info.description: idrak: one command-line tool for Idrak: check devices, chat with and serve language models, manage models, benchmark, fine-tune and prepare data.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert rows between CSV, JSON Lines and JSON (Parquet is read), and chat layouts to

options.name: --out
options.description: OUT as an option

options.name: --type
options.description: the element type of the written weights (default bf16)

options.name: --force
options.description: write into a folder that is not empty

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
say what would be written
GGUF weights are dequantized (float32 in memory, one model at a time) and written in --type.

options.name: --device
options.description: cpu, cuda:0, vulkan:1, hip:0 (default: the default device)

options.name: --plugin
options.description: load an assembly that registers formats, families, ... (repeatable)

options.name: --json
options.description: machine-readable output

options.name: --quiet
options.description: less output; -v, --verbose: more

options.name: --cache
options.description: the cache folder (default IDRAK_CACHE or ~/.cache/idrak)

options.name: --config
options.description: the config file (default IDRAK_CONFIG or ~/.idrak/config.json)

options.name: --log
options.description:
also write every line, verbose ones included, to FILE
@FILE           read arguments from FILE, one per line (@@text: a literal @text)

options.name: --output
options.description: write the command's main output to FILE

options.name: --format
options.description: text, json, csv or md (tables)

options.name: --color
options.description: auto, always or never (NO_COLOR still wins); --plain: no Unicode or progress line

options.name: --offline
options.description: use only what is cached; a download is an error

options.name: --threads
options.description: CPU threads; --seed N: one seed for sampling, shuffling and initialization

options.name: --timeout
options.description: give up after a duration (30s, 5m, 1h30m)

options.name: --lang
options.description: messages in en or ar (config "lang", IDRAK_LANG); --lang-render auto, visual or logical
